## Testing Checklist

<!-- Check all that you've tested -->

### Functionality
- [ ] Changes work as expected
- [ ] No console errors

### Accessibility
- [ ] Keyboard navigation works (Tab, Enter, Escape)
- [ ] Tested with screen reader (NVDA, JAWS, or VoiceOver)
- [ ] Color contrast meets WCAG 2.1 AA standards
- [ ] Focus states are visible
- [ ] Semantic HTML used appropriately

### Responsive Design
- [ ] Tested on mobile (< 768px)

- [ ] Mobile menu works correctly (if applicable)

### Cross-Browser Testing
- [ ] Chrome/Chromium
- [ ] Firefox
- [ ] Safari (desktop or mobile)
- [ ] Edge

### Performance
- [ ] No new performance regressions
- [ ] Images optimized (if applicable)
- [ ] Scripts load efficiently
- [ ] Animations don't cause jank

### Code Quality
- [ ] Code follows project style guidelines
- [ ] Comments added for complex logic
- [ ] No unnecessary code or console.logs
- [ ] HTML validates (no errors)
